title: Keeping Time with the Skies
summary: Days, months and years from the Earth, Moon and Sun. Solar, lunar and lunisolar calendars, leap years and adhik maas.

ib.note: Links to MYP Individuals & Societies (history of calendars)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 11: Keeping Time with the Skies

objectives: I can explain how the day, month and year come from the motions of the Earth and Moon.
I can compare solar, lunar and lunisolar calendars.
I can explain why leap years and leap months (adhik maas) are needed.
misconceptions: A lunar month is exactly 30 days.
All festivals fall on the same date every year.
